title: Posting of license and loan charges.
bodyText: Any installment lender offering an installment loan shall conspicuously and continuously post, at any place of business where installment loans are made, the license required pursuant to this chapter and a notice of the loan charges imposed for installment loans.
bodyHtml: [§480J-12]  Posting of license and loan charges.  Any installment lender offering an installment loan shall conspicuously and continuously post, at any place of business where installment loans are made, the license required pursuant to this chapter and a notice of the loan charges imposed for installment loans. [L 2021, c 56, pt of §2]
